evals.prompt: Buatkan skema multi-tenant invoices di PostgreSQL dengan Row-Level Security (RLS).
evals.expected_output: DDL enabling RLS with FORCE, subquery (SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), ''))::uuid, composite index with tenant_id leading.
assertions: ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

evals.prompt: Optimasi query SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC yang lemot (1.4s).
evals.expected_output: Applies 5-step optimization flow; replaces Seq Scan with composite index (customer_id, created_at DESC); removes unnecessary SELECT *; validates execution time drops to <5ms.

evals.prompt: Migrasikan kolom phone_number ke phone_e164 pada tabel users berukuran 10 juta baris di production.
evals.expected_output: Designs 4-phase zero-downtime expand-contract migration; DDL with lock_timeout = '2s'; cursor backfill in 1000-row chunks with 50ms pause.
